insights.title: Trust turns discovery into a decision.
insights.finding: Finding a class does not automatically lead to enrollment. Parents look for reassurance before committing.
insights.direction: Make reviews, testimonials, and coach credibility visible while comparing classes.

insights.title: Convenience and child comfort shape the choice.
insights.finding: Timings, distance, routine, and the child’s comfort influence decisions alongside perceived quality.
insights.direction: Bring location, fees, timings, and class details together for easy comparison.

insights.title: The problem continues behind the scenes.
insights.finding: Institutes manage scattered inquiries, follow-ups, payments, and records through manual work.
insights.direction: Support the institute journey with clearer dashboards, tracking, and communication.

insights.title: Adoption is a behavioural challenge.
insights.finding: Technology alone does not replace familiar word-of-mouth, calls, or WhatsApp habits.
insights.direction: Show value quickly through familiar, low-friction interactions.

insights.title: Fragmentation creates an opportunity to connect.
insights.finding: Discovery, comparison, enrollment, and ongoing management happen across separate channels.
insights.direction: Create one coherent journey from browsing to confirmation and beyond.

insights.title: The value must be felt before it is demanded.
insights.finding: Users do not always perceive enough pain to actively seek a new platform.
insights.direction: Communicate practical benefits through clear messaging and an immediately useful experience.

opportunities.response: Discovery-first browsing, nearby classes, and optional filters.
Reviews, testimonials, social proof, and rich class pages.
A clear inquiry, documents, payment, and confirmation flow.
Lead tracking, applicant management, reports, and clearer dashboards.
